title: Authorization review
text: Verify authorization records, service dates and applicable payer rules. Escalate missing or conflicting documentation to a specialist. Do not assume retroactive authorization is available.
answer: Compare the authorization record with the service date and applicable payer rules. If documentation is missing or inconsistent, escalate to a specialist. Do not assume retroactive authorization is available.

title: Eligibility review
text: Verify coverage at date of service using approved sources. Document discrepancies and route corrections for review.
answer: Verify coverage at the date of service, document discrepancies, and route any correction for review.

title: Coding review
text: Qualified coding staff must review documentation before any code change. Never change codes solely to obtain payment.
answer: Route the claim to qualified coding staff to review documentation. Do not change codes solely to obtain payment.

title: Filing deadlines
text: Verify submission history and payer-specific filing and appeal deadlines before taking action.
answer: Check submission history and the applicable payer-specific deadlines.

title: Denial prioritization
text: Prioritize using denied amount, verified deadlines and appeal eligibility. Assign owners and track actual recoveries. Age alone does not establish appeal eligibility.
answer: Prioritize by denied amount, verified deadlines and appeal eligibility. Assign an owner and track actual recoveries. Age alone does not establish appeal eligibility.
